adoption_funnel.L1_CLI_discovered: >=1 Bash tool_use command containing `python -m provenlattice` together with `--help` or `-h`
adoption_funnel.L2_CLI_invoked: >=1 Bash tool_use command containing `python -m provenlattice` (any arguments)
adoption_funnel.L3_task_context_requested: >=1 such command whose arguments include the `task-context` subcommand
adoption_funnel.L4_facts_returned: returned_facts >= 1 extracted by the frozen normalize_trace from a task-context-v0 payload
adoption_funnel.L5_facts_used: preregistered proxy: the symbol token (last `:`-segment of a returned fact_id) appears in the final patch text or in a tool_use command issued after the first task-context-v0 tool_result
adoption_funnel.note: recorded per cell from frozen normalized traces + records; identical detectors for both arms; L3/L4 are impossible on arm A by inventory and their absence there is expected, not a failure

change_scope: exposure pointer is the ONLY variable added on top of the frozen D9-C6 protocol (same manifest cells, same problem_statement bytes, same frozen base commits, same inventories/runtimes, same runner lifecycle, same blinded review protocol); fresh workspaces are materialized by the frozen prepare lifecycle; D9-C6 post-run worktrees are never reused

exposure_gates.GATE_CAPABILITY_REACHABLE: capability conclusions require >= 1 B cell with L4; with 0 the batch must conclude capability INCONCLUSIVE regardless of outcome delta
exposure_gates.GATE_EXPOSURE_L2: B cells with L2 >= 1, else EXPOSURE_FAILED_AT_DISCOVERY
exposure_gates.GATE_EXPOSURE_L3: if L2 >= 1 and B cells with L3 == 0, then ADOPTION_GAP_AT_SELECTION
exposure_gates.purpose: no repeat of D9-C6 where returned_facts=0 was only explained after unseal; exposure status is now a first-class early result
exposure_gates.reporting_order: funnel counts and gate states are computed from execution records and reported BEFORE the blind review phase begins; outcome unblinding happens only after the review freeze
